description: Discover the playable examples bundled with this release. Returns compact summaries and exact refs; does not load or play anything. Use schema_version: 1. Limit defaults to 20 (1–100); optional source/id filters and opaque cursor; kind, when supplied, must be invention. Copy a returned ref into describe_example, or into load_invention to play it. An item the browser cannot play says why under browser.

ContentKind.description: Available musical content classification, independent of registered types.

ContentSource.description: Delivery provenance; it never changes package identity.
